html: דרר (√ of foll. words: Arabic دَرَّ —1. stream, flow abundantly (of milk, tears, rain, etc.), cf. i. דְּרוֹר. 2. be abundant, luxuriant (of herbage), cf. دَرْدَارٌ a kind of tree, now elm (Lane), & דַּרְדַּר. 3. run vehemently, easily (of horse), cf. دَرِيرٌ swift horse, or other beast, & ii. דְּרוֹר. 4. give light, shine (of lamp) cf. كَوْكَبٌ دُرِّىٌّ shining star, دُرِّىٌّ glistening or shining of sword, دُرٌّ pearls (coll.) & דַּר; hence prob. דָּרוֹם).
